# Final Execution Plan

## Files to inspect before choosing changes

- package.json and all verification/render scripts relevant to scene, character, persistence, browser, package, and export.
- src scene/project schemas, performance composition, render bridges, character geometry, customizer, serialization, restoration, preview, camera, text, and export.
- existing demo data and proof generators.

## Files that may be rewritten

Only files demonstrated incomplete by evidence. Every rewritten source file will retain the required three-line header, tabs, descriptive JSDoc, and fewer than 120 lines. New responsibilities will be split into small modules.

## Ordered execution

1. Build dependency and feature matrix.
2. Run focused baseline tests.
3. Create the one-minute project through the native contract.
4. Add tests for timing, performance channels, persistence, preview, and export.
5. Render production browser courts and representative frames.
6. Export packaged media and verify artifacts.
7. Run complete verification and compliance audits.
8. Re-read all changed files and close ledgers with direct evidence.
